title: Align link draft replay identity with full key generation
description: Cross-document correctness review found draft-lichen-link-01 §4.3/§5 still describes a trust store indexed by peer EUI-64 and a per-peer replay window, with successful verification returning only a peer identity. Updated spec/02-physical-link §4.4 normatively keys replay by (SignerPublicKey, opaque KeyGeneration), forbids SIID/EUI/address aliases as replay keys, and retires generations independently. Revise the draft so SIID only selects a bounded candidate set, verification returns full public key plus current generation token, and replay/fragment state uses that tuple; remove the misleading per-(peer,epoch) wording.
